svg.title: Detailed authentication and authorization flow, clearly separated
svg.desc: Numbered arrows show the flow: browser to Azure AD to app to Key Vault and back. Detail pills below each node carry the extra context: Azure AD has Admin and User roles assigned via AAD groups, the app is a Flask demo doing the OIDC handshake and role check, and Key Vault holds an auto-rotating client-id and client-secret retrieved via fetch-secrets.sh or the CSI driver.
